should_findings.card_or_section: Plan § Review ownership and timing (G3.5, G4.1/G4.2/G4.3, G5, G6.1/G6.2, G7.4-pre/post); Goal § Required execution sequence items 5–9; Log § OPERATOR DIRECTIVE — review cadence relaxation
should_findings.evidence: Plan still requires per-card Grok pre/post around each [XHARD] card and a standalone G3.5 before T4. Log directive (authoritative) replaces those pairs with one subsection review at G1/G2/G3/G4/G5/G6.3 plus up to three end-stage Sol reviews. Goal still lists G3.5 before T4 and Grok pre/post for T4.1–T4.3.
should_findings.counterexample: An executor could wait for a missing standalone G3.5 before T4, or skip G7.4-pre because the directive listed it among replaced per-card pairs, or treat “up to 3” as permission to run zero end reviews.
should_findings.disposition: Documentation lag, not a Batch 1 block. Until a docs-only reconciliation, execute the joint reading in downstream_conditions. Do not invent a replacement gate. Do not rewrite G0.

should_findings.disposition: T3.2 tests assert typed request/checkpoint emission only. Executable recover-blocked / rebind / chain-start fixtures belong to T4.2 under the seed/import environment. No new card.
